content: Durughulu du Yinyuni Yisyeme
Ave yilumbu yi mumengu Patekote yimatolile, bango yitu bamabe baghukeme mbure mosi.
Sundila, nduku djimarughe o djulu, djimabe nane mungudi wuneni. Nduku eni djimabase ndaghu adji bamabe baghukemine.
Kaboghu, bakelabe ndimi nane milutsu mi mudji. Tsikekakunu, tsikesundughe na tsiketsane mu kale mutu.
Botsu bamabasu na Yinyuni Yisyeme na bamabande uvose mambembu masusu, nane Yinyuni amaveyilaange kale mutu mumavose.
O Serusaleme, wumabe baSwife bamayitsaange Nzambi, bamarughesene mu malongu motsu ma butambe.
Ave bamawululu nduku eni, yinombu yi batu yikeghukeme. Yimakambulu tinde ukambulu, mumbari kale mutu amabaghulungu uvose mu dilongu dyandi.
Bamasutu na bakebanyungilaange, novosaange rye: «Batu bebabe, bise Ngalile!
Yike tsyeni twibaghululu, uvose dilongu di mutu-mutu?
Va ghari etu, bamosi bise Patese, Medese, Elame, Mesopotami, o Sudé na Kapadose, basusu bise Pon na Asi,
Firisi, Pafili, Yisipete, bamosi o musyengi wu Libi adji bambene na Sirene, na botsu abamarughesene o Rome,

bise Kerete na Arabi. Va ghari etu, bane bamaburu baSwife, abane wandi bamarughesene o malongu masusu, bamavayile Nzambi baSwife yitu. Yike tsyeni twibaghululu uvose maboti ma Nzambi mu mambembu metu.»
Botsu bamasutu na bamaghambu na dyuvose. Bamakewivulaange yiri: «Adidi tsyé diwendili?»
Tumbe basusu, bamapedjingi botsu abamasinge Nzambi novose rye: «Badji mu malangi!»
Pyere evosili mughungi

Pyere na dighumi na yilumbi yimosi, bamareleme va ghari mughungi, na Pyere akevose rye: «Bise Sudé, na djenu botsu abe dwitsani o Serusaleme, wulwanu adivyoyi na dyo ngadutsingule, limbighanu matudji.
Batu beni babe bagha balange nane dwitasili, mumbari wisi aki kedi.
Tumbe vave, adimavosu na mubiyitsi Sowele:

content.text: nyuveghe Yinyuni yami mu batu botsu.
mu basalitsi bami botsu ba babaale
ne yilumbu yi Fumu yike rughe,

content: Bise Yisrayele, wulwanu adi menu ngadutsingule. Djesu mwise Nasarete amabe mutu awu Nzambi amadulase munongu andi. Amadivaghe ave amamuveyile musughe wuvaghe bimaghe na bilimbe bi mangolu. Djandi amadughusu va ghari enu nane djenubeni dwididjabili.
Nane djabeni Nzambi amakunzile mu dughanu dwandi ne mambu meni makelabene, djenu dumaghangise Djesu na batu baghane yitu, bakemughomine nomuboke va kurusu.
Tumbe Nzambi amamudjeyise mu maghughe ma dufu, akemughabuse monyu, mumbari Djesu mbé aghorungule ughangu na mangolu ma dufu.
Kaghe Davide amavose mu djandi rye:

content.text: Ladibandu, murime ami wumabile mu nzangu,
na munu ami wiwimbili na yinyunge.
Ne dunyuru dwami dube dubase na yitu,
mumbari Fumu aghonzile o bulongu bu bobafu,
na wughogharu bwé Yibyatsi yaghu Yisyeme,
wumbase na nzangu ave nyubile va wusu aghu.”

content: Baane ba tadji, menu nine musughe wudutsingule na bureti mu dyambu di kaaghe etu Davide. Djandi amafu, na amatswighu na mbine andi djikilabene tena vave, va ghari etu.
Djandi amabighe mumba amadjabaange yiri Nzambi amaleve pesi mu djabeni bwé, wumosi mu bateghule bandi obe yivinze yandi va yitsighe yi bukaghe.
Mu posulu eni, Davide amabighe durambughulu du Kirisete o dufu. Adine amavosile rye:

content.text: na dunyuru dwandi dusamabole o ghari mbine.”

content: Djesu eni nyiranguni, Nzambi amamughabuse monyu. Djetu botswanu tudji bambedji.
Tate Nzambi amamatise Djesu o mabaale mandi. Djandi amamuveghe Yinyuni Yisyeme ayimavangenu. Djawandi amatupuyile yoni, adine dwilabi nowulu vave.
Davide djabeni asamamate o djulu, tumbe amavose rye:

content.text: tena nyusunze bavinitsi baghu otsi makulu maghu.”

content: Mukute wotsu wu Yisrayele widjabi na bureti yiri Nzambi amamubyatse Fumu na Kirisete. Djesu édjine adji dutsi ghomine noboke va kurusu.»
Bango yitu bateghe
Bapikile ba botsu abamawulu mbembu édjine baketsyemughe, na bamawivule Pyere na bilumbi bimosi yiri: «Bane ba tadji, yike tsyeni turungule wuvayile?»
Pyere amabawaghule rye: «Fungulanu nodunde mabi menu, na kale mutu mbé obatusu mu dine di Djesu Kirisete. Vaghanu nane, mabi menu motandu, na dukedile Yinyuni Yisyeme.
Nzambi amaghane wudivaghe ombu bane benu, djenubeni, na botsu abetsani o malongu mavale, batu botsu nane Fumu Nzambi obanengilile.»
Pyere amabwévose pwele mambu, na amabawarise novose rye: «Singanu dughobutsu mumbari monyu enu, wukekakene na mutsanu wubive wu bulongu bwébubu!»
Botsu abamawulu nosinge mbembu Pyere, bamabatusu. Mu yilumbu yeni, tangudji tosini-yiryeru (3 000) tsi batu bamasobene nowu mu yinombu.
Dibundu diteghe
Temu tsyotsu, bamawulungu ndonzulu bilumbi na musighe, bakebeghange monyu dibure-ngudji, bamadjangaange nosambilaange va mosi.
Kale mutu amawulungu keri, mumbari Nzambi amadughusungu pwele bilimbe na bimaghe mu nzalusulu bilumbi.
Bango yitu botsu bamabangaange mbure mosi na bamaghabenaange byotsu abimabangaange byowu.
Bamasumbisaange maboti mowu, na bakeghabenaange badoli djobotsu, nane kale mutu amabilaange na nzale.
Bilumbu byotsu, na murime mosi, bamaghukemange o dulombili du ndaghu Nzambi. Bameneghabaange bighudji mu mandaghu mowu na bamadjangaange na nzangu na murime pwelele.
Bamayitsaange Nzambi na mukute wotsu wumabanyungilaange. Na Fumu amabwesaange kale yilumbu mu yinombu yowu botsu abe amaghobulaange.
